name: @absolutejs/agent-exchange-oauth
description: Hardened OAuth grant exchange using PAR, PKCE, RAR, resource indicators, issuer validation, and DPoP.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --root src --sourcemap --target=browser --external @absolutejs/agent-exchange && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public
